Marky - more than anyone - should know that you can't paper over the cracks forever.

overview: What happens in Vegas usually stays in Vegas, but behind the flashing lights and million-dollar jackpots is a world visitors have never seen before. For the first time, Discovery pulls back the curtain on the legendary Golden Nugget, one of Las Vegas' most iconic casinos, to follow the larger-than-life personalities responsible for managing demanding high rollers, millions of dollars, and nonstop drama every day. Just off the chaos of busy Fremont Street, cameras capture the real-life and often shocking moments that unfold around the clock: unruly guests, high-pressure special events and the relentless efforts required to keep thousands of people safe and entertained each day. Whether it's breaking up a late-night club brawl, responding to an embarrassing medical emergency or racing to move sharks from a 200,000-gallon shark tank, the staff must be ready for whatever Vegas throws their way.

overview: As a child, He Mei, the daughter of Rongcheng's wealthiest family, falls victim to a ruthless scheme orchestrated by the family nanny, Zhang Xin. Her mother dies in a fire, her adopted brother He Shi prevents her from escaping, and the family butler eventually abducts and sells her to a remote mountain village. Years later, He Mei returns under the name Li Zhangxin, only to discover that Zhang Xin has taken her mother's place as the mistress of the He family. He Shi has become a reckless spendthrift, while the butler now serves as Zhang Xin's loyal accomplice. Determined to reclaim her identity and uncover the truth, Li Zhangxin infiltrates the household as a nanny. She rescues her pregnant sister-in-law, Shu Roujing, from domestic abuse and cares for He Yu, who has been left unconscious after a car accident. When He Yu wakes up, he grows suspicious of her, forcing Li Zhangxin to claim that she entered the He family because she is in love with him. Through constant suspicion and confrontation, the two gradually develop genuine feelings for each other. When the patriarch of the He family returns, Li Zhangxin finally proves her true identity. He Yu also discovers that Zhang Xin and He Shi were behind his car accident and joins Li Zhangxin in seeking revenge. Together, they carefully set their plans in motion, exposing the pair's darkest secrets and turning them against each other. But just as Li Zhangxin finally reclaims her rightful place as the He family heiress, she discovers that the true mastermind behind everything has only just emerged.
title: The Heiress Strikes Back

overview: Tomé leads a double life of success and secret filmed encounters. His mistress Carolina and his secretary Elsa unite to expose him before his mall project launch, each with different motives for revenge.

An eccentric, wealthy old man named Don Leopoldo meets Rina. Despising his greedy family, he manipulates Rina into marrying him purely to ensure his fortune passes to her rather than his sister-in-law, Doña Rafaela. Leopoldo dies shortly after the marriage, leaving Rina a massive fortune and estate. Doña Rafaela plots ruthlessly to manipulate Rina and strip her of the inheritance. Complications peak when Rina falls in love with Rafaela's handsome son, Carlos Augusto.
title: Rina

overview: To solve a border missing persons case, Lian Ming, a detective from Lingdong, also infiltrates Black Island Prison undercover. Wen Bang, a former special forces operative from Nanling, is compelled to enter the prison and serve his sentence in order to rescue Yachun and her daughter, who depend on him as much as he depends on them. Behind bars, the two move from mutual hostility to mutual support. As they join forces against the gangs, they must also outwit the mounting crises their true identities create. Even as they slowly expose the prison's criminal truth, a far greater threat is closing in...

overview: En Coma centers around a young woman named Anabel who survives a devastating explosion but is left trapped in a deep, unresponsive coma. While she is completely paralyzed in her hospital bed, corrupt individuals target her body to illegally harvest and sell her heart for $500,000. A male nurse named Rafael has a supernatural gift—he can hear the spirits of the dead and the subconscious minds of people stuck between life and death. Anabel's consciousness manages to reach out to Rafael, pleading for his help. He must find a way to protect her body and keep her alive before her enemies can find and kill her.
title: En Coma

overview: A struggling TV network hires a young theatrical producer to improve their programming, but he finds that it is a hotbed of incompetence and jealous backstabbing.

overview: After an accident leaves Shen Mo with amnesia, he mistakes Ji Mingxuan, the man who saved him, for his lover. But when Shen Mo regains his memories, the six months they spent loving each other become completely erased. Desperate to keep Shen Mo by his side, Ji Mingxuan proposes a three-year ""contract lover"" arrangement. When two people are already in love, can a contract still keep their hearts in check? Adapted from a popular Jinjiang Literature City novel! A heartbreaking romance meets contract lovers in a love story that is as sweet as it is painfully addictive.
title: The Missing Piece

overview: Good-bye Mr. Black is based on an old story of the Count of Monte Cristo, It tells the story of a young man who is betrayed by his best friend and his lover who framed him for a crime he did not commit, who then returns with a new identity to exact his revenge.

overview: A story about the love and relationships of people in an office, a place that is not only a workplace but also a place where someone's feelings are made clear.

overview: Actress Xia Yi Mo unexpectedly lands a role in the historical drama "The Scent of Ink" - the very one she was originally cast in. Hoping to play the lead, she instead finds herself portraying a maid, a guard, and a stepmother. She has only five chances to play this role, and to return to reality, she must save Xue Ruo Wan - the main character played by her former best friend. When she finally transforms into the villainous supporting character Xue Ke Ying - the one she fears most - the familiar plot gradually spirals out of control: her relationship with her sister shifts from hostile to one of life-or-death stakes, and her relationship with the cold-hearted General Ning Yuan Ci evolves from mutual trials to genuine affection. Behind the life-threatening crisis lies a conspiracy orchestrated through marriage. Will she be able to escape her predetermined fate and rewrite the ending for herself and her loved ones?
title: Echoes Through Ink
